checks.description: Gate-zero. The build has a hero or header image module whose src is the verified-servable header for that instructor and class, on an approved Ortto host, per context/instructors/_EMAIL-IMAGE-MANIFEST.md.
checks.rule: Fail and block when the build has no hero or header image module, when the header src is the og:image variant (*_CLASS_PAGE_* or *_RIGHTGRADIENT.JPG, which returns 403), when the header is not the manifest's verified header for that instructor and class, when the manifest status for that header is pending or BLOCKED, or when the header src is on a non-approved host (a raw dt92b02v6m7lx.cloudfront.net object is verified at source but is not an approved email host; it must be staged to the Ortto CDN or proven by an inbox send-test). The manifest is the source of truth for verified headers. This is gate-zero: a build that fails it does not advance and the header is the precondition for the build. Same finding as commit 6bf87a4 (in-page CLASSCOVER is the header, never the og:image).

checks.description: Every image module is a real, rights-cleared Maharat asset, traceable to the catalog, the image map, or a published page.
checks.rule: Fail when an image is generated, stock, or otherwise unlicensed, or when its rights cannot be traced to the catalog, the image map, or a published Maharat page.

checks.description: Every img src and VML background src is on the approved Ortto CDN (m.autopilotapp.com, ic.autopilotapp.com, app-rsrc.getbee.io for social icons), not a raw Drive link or a hotlink-protected CloudFront object.
checks.rule: Fail when an img src is a raw Google Drive link or a hotlink-protected CloudFront object (for example dt92b02v6m7lx.cloudfront.net); the fix stages the bytes to the approved CDN or proves render with an inbox send-test. A direct server-side fetch of the Bassam class cover returns 403.

checks.description: No Arabic or English text is baked into any image; the headline is a live copy slot over a text-free background.
checks.rule: Fail when text is baked into an image (for example a class cover with a baked title), rather than rendered as a live copy slot over a text-free background image.

checks.description: Any brand color in a rendered or composed asset matches the constitution: near-black #141414, panel #1A1A1A, emerald #009975.
checks.rule: Fail when an asset uses a color off the constitution, including the pending gold #C4963C or the pending panel #1c1c1c, in a customer-facing email until Ahmed signs off.

checks.description: Each module is the right width and aspect for its slot, with the subject inside a safe area.
checks.rule: Fail when a module is the wrong width or aspect for its slot (Hero and FeatureImage 600 wide, ClassCardGrid a consistent 3-up, LogoBar about 118px, social icons about 28 to 30px) or when the subject is cropped outside a safe area.

checks.description: Every meaningful image carries real, descriptive alt text in the build's language, never empty and never the filename; decorative spacers are marked decorative.
checks.rule: Fail when a meaningful image has missing, empty, or filename alt text, or when a decorative image is not marked decorative. Arabic alt for an Arabic build.

checks.description: Any image picturing or naming an instructor is blocked until the catalog status is confirmed, and carries only page-cleared, rights-cleared creative.
checks.rule: Fail when an image pictures or names an instructor whose catalog status is unconfirmed, or when a held-back claim appears in the pixels or the alt text. A class-card grid with an unconfirmed instructor or a rights-unconfirmed cover is dropped, not shipped.

checks.description: A spec-only review blocks final pass on the checks that need the hosted asset.
checks.rule: Fail (block final pass) when the review is spec-only and a host-dependent check (approved-cdn-hosting, the inbox send-test) cannot be verified without the staged asset; flag it as an open item rather than passing it through.

checks.description: The gate returns a binary verdict with a structured fix list on fail.
checks.rule: Result is pass only when every check passes on every image module; otherwise fail with one fix item per failing check, each naming the check, the offending module by its src and role, and the required change.
